external: Opens an external booking site in a new tab.

original: Product title shown in its original language.
partnersBody: Check dates, options and cancellation terms directly with the provider.
storyTitle:

and the open sea.
storyBody: From sailing along the coast to discovering a different view around every corner. Find your own way to experience Busan.
availability: Confirm availability and cancellation or refund terms with the provider.
readOnly: Browse without an account. Booking and payment take place on the provider's website.
metaDescription: Explore Busan travel courses, attractions, restaurants and maps. Combine short routes for free. Book experiences and accommodation with external providers.
pricingNotice: The site is currently free to use. An optional KRW 1,900/month plan is being planned and has not launched; no subscription is charged. Travel bookings, including experiences and accommodation, cost extra.
